description: Auditor General's Department - Amendments of Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the miunute on the Sri Lanka Audit Service
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with amendments to the Sri Lanka Audit Service regulations, including salary scales, promotion qualifications, and appointment procedures for public service positions (Deputy Auditors General, Additional Auditors General). It involves public service recruitment, promotion criteria, and service conditions administered by the Public Service Commission, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government personnel changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
